preconditions.description: The number of integers n must be between 1 and 100000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= b_i < 2**60 for b_i in b)
preconditions.description: Each integer b_i must be at least 1 and less than 2^60.
The length of the list b must be equal to n.

postconditions.expression: stdout == 'No' if not any_valid_permutation else True
postconditions.description: If no valid permutation exists, output 'No'.
If a valid permutation exists, output 'Yes' followed by n integers.

postconditions.expression: all(a[i] < a[i + 1] for i in range(n - 1))
postconditions.description: The sequence a_i must be strictly increasing.
